title: 雅思·科技与互联网精选 · 64 句
description: 围绕本主题练习论点、理由、条件、让步与政策评价；中英对照及逐题讲解，难度 3–5。

items.zh: 算法可以快速筛选申请，但速度本身并不能证明筛选结果公平。
items.en: Algorithms can screen applications quickly, but speed alone does not demonstrate that the results are fair.
answers: Algorithms can screen applications quickly, but speed alone does not demonstrate that the results are fair.
items.notes: screen 作动词表示筛选；alone 限定 speed，区分效率与公平。

items.zh: 只要用户无法理解自己同意了什么，隐私条款再详细也未必有用。
items.en: However detailed a privacy policy is, it may be of little use if users cannot understand what they are agreeing to.
answers: However detailed a privacy policy is, it may be of little use if users cannot understand what they are agreeing to.
items.notes: however + 形容词引导让步从句；be of little use 表示用处不大。

items.zh: 为老年人保留线下服务，可以防止数字化变成新的障碍。
items.en: Keeping offline services available to older people can prevent digitalisation from becoming a new barrier.
answers: Keeping offline services available to older people can prevent digitalisation from becoming a new barrier.
items.notes: keep + 宾语 + 形容词；prevent ... from doing 指防止出现某种结果。

items.zh: 人工智能生成的答案越流畅，人们就可能越容易忽略其中缺乏证据的部分。
items.en: The more fluent an AI-generated answer is, the easier it may be for people to overlook its lack of evidence.
answers: The more fluent an AI-generated answer is, the easier it may be for people to overlook its lack of evidence.
items.notes: the more ... the easier ... 表示相关变化；may 保留推断的不确定性。

items.zh: 如果工人能够接受再培训，自动化就有可能创造新的工作路径。
items.en: Automation could open up new career paths if workers had access to retraining.
answers: Automation could open up new career paths if workers had access to retraining.
items.notes: could + 动词与 if + 过去式构成假设；have access to 表示有机会获得。

items.zh: 与单纯增加屏幕使用时间相比，教会孩子判断信息来源更有教育价值。
items.en: Teaching children to assess information sources has greater educational value than simply increasing their screen time.
answers: Teaching children to assess information sources has greater educational value than simply increasing their screen time.
items.notes: 用平行动名词比较两种活动；assess sources 指评估信息来源的可靠性。

items.zh: 被收集用于导航的位置数据，不应在用户不知情的情况下被用于广告。
items.en: Location data collected for navigation should not be used for advertising without the user's knowledge.
answers: Location data collected for navigation should not be used for advertising without the user's knowledge.
items.notes: collected 是过去分词定语；主句被动语态突出数据用途限制。

items.zh: 技术故障一旦影响支付系统，小商户就可能立刻失去收入。
items.en: Once a technical failure disrupts a payment system, small retailers may immediately lose revenue.
answers: Once a technical failure disrupts a payment system, small retailers may immediately lose revenue.
items.notes: once 说明触发条件；disrupt a system 表示扰乱系统运行。

items.zh: 问题在于谁应对自动化决策负责，而不只是算法是否准确。
items.en: The issue is who should be accountable for automated decisions, not merely whether the algorithm is accurate.
answers: The issue is who should be accountable for automated decisions, not merely whether the algorithm is accurate.
items.notes: who 与 whether 从句作表语；be accountable for 表示应对某事负责。

items.zh: 虽然远程办公软件让协作更方便，它也可能模糊工作与休息的边界。
items.en: While remote-working software makes collaboration easier, it may also blur the boundary between work and rest.
answers: While remote-working software makes collaboration easier, it may also blur the boundary between work and rest.
items.notes: while 在此表示让步；blur the boundary between A and B 是常用搭配。

items.zh: 只有当用户能够撤回授权时，数据共享的同意才真正有意义。
items.en: Only when users can withdraw permission does consent to data sharing become meaningful.
answers: Only when users can withdraw permission does consent to data sharing become meaningful.
items.notes: only when 前置，主句用 does 倒装；consent to 后接名词或动名词。

items.zh: 平台可以通过解释推荐某条内容的原因，帮助用户识别推荐机制。
items.en: Platforms could help users understand recommendation systems by explaining why a particular item is shown.
answers: Platforms could help users understand recommendation systems by explaining why a particular item is shown.
items.notes: by doing 说明手段；why 从句嵌入 explaining 后。

items.zh: 并非每项能被自动化的任务都值得被自动化。
items.en: Not every task that can be automated is worth automating.
answers: Not every task that can be automated is worth automating.
items.notes: not every 是部分否定；be worth doing 用主动形式表达被动含义。

items.zh: 由于旧设备不再获得安全更新，延长其使用寿命可能带来额外风险。
items.en: Because older devices no longer receive security updates, extending their lifespan may carry additional risks.
answers: Because older devices no longer receive security updates, extending their lifespan may carry additional risks.
items.notes: because 说明原因；carry risks 表示带来风险，动名词短语作主句主语。

items.zh: 当学校采用监考软件时，必须考虑误报会如何影响学生。
items.en: When schools adopt remote proctoring software, they must consider how false alarms will affect students.
answers: When schools adopt remote proctoring software, they must consider how false alarms will affect students.
items.notes: when 引出政策情境；false alarm 指误报，不是已确认违规。

items.zh: 网络接入虽然重要，但没有无障碍设计，部分残障用户仍无法使用服务。
items.en: Internet access matters, yet some users with disabilities remain excluded when services lack accessible design.
answers: Internet access matters, yet some users with disabilities remain excluded when services lack accessible design.
items.notes: yet 引出限制；accessible design 指方便残障用户使用的设计。

items.zh: 为了降低对单一供应商的依赖，机构可以要求数据能够以通用格式导出。
items.en: To reduce dependence on a single supplier, organisations could require data to be exportable in a common format.
answers: To reduce dependence on a single supplier, organisations could require data to be exportable in a common format.
items.notes: 句首 to do 表示目的；require + 宾语 + to be ... 提出技术要求。

items.zh: 手机通知频繁打断注意力，这可能使需要持续思考的工作更难完成。
items.en: Frequent phone notifications interrupt attention, which may make work requiring sustained thought harder to complete.
answers: Frequent phone notifications interrupt attention, which may make work requiring sustained thought harder to complete.
items.notes: which 指代前面整件事；requiring 是现在分词定语，修饰 work。

items.zh: 如果公司事先测试过备用系统，这次服务中断本来可能更短。
items.en: The service outage might have been shorter if the company had tested its backup system beforehand.
answers: The service outage might have been shorter if the company had tested its backup system beforehand.
items.notes: 过去虚拟条件句讨论已发生事件；might 表示可能性而非确定结论。

items.zh: 把更多数据输入模型，并不必然能纠正训练样本中的偏差。
items.en: Feeding more data into a model does not necessarily correct bias in its training sample.
answers: Feeding more data into a model does not necessarily correct bias in its training sample.
items.notes: feed A into B 表示输入；not necessarily 否定必然关系。

items.zh: 真正需要评估的是这项工具改善了哪些决策，以及代价是什么。
items.en: What needs to be assessed is which decisions the tool improves and at what cost.
answers: What needs to be assessed is which decisions the tool improves and at what cost.
items.notes: what 从句作主语，内含被动不定式；at what cost 补充评价维度。

items.zh: 不论一项应用多么受欢迎，用户都应能够删除自己的账户。
items.en: No matter how popular an app becomes, users should be able to delete their accounts.
answers: No matter how popular an app becomes, users should be able to delete their accounts.
items.notes: no matter how 引导让步从句；be able to 表示具备实际能力。

items.zh: 人脸识别可以简化身份核验；不过，识别错误必须有便捷的申诉渠道。
items.en: Facial recognition can simplify identity checks; however, there must be an accessible way to challenge identification errors.
answers: Facial recognition can simplify identity checks; however, there must be an accessible way to challenge identification errors.
items.notes: however 连接独立分句时使用分号；challenge an error 指对错误结果提出异议。

items.zh: 与其禁止所有新工具，大学不如明确说明哪些用途是可接受的。
items.en: Rather than ban every new tool, universities should specify which uses are acceptable.
answers: Rather than ban every new tool, universities should specify which uses are acceptable.
items.notes: rather than 后接动词原形；which 从句作 specify 的宾语。

items.zh: 机器翻译能降低沟通门槛，但法律文件仍可能需要专业人员核对。
items.en: Machine translation can lower communication barriers, though legal documents may still require professional review.
answers: Machine translation can lower communication barriers, though legal documents may still require professional review.
items.notes: though 引出适用范围的限制。

items.zh: 语音助手若无法识别某些口音，就可能让部分用户更难获得服务。
items.en: Voice assistants that fail to recognise certain accents may make services harder for some users to access.
answers: Voice assistants that fail to recognise certain accents may make services harder for some users to access.
items.notes: make sth harder to do：使某事更难完成。

items.zh: 人工智能在一种医院环境中表现良好，并不保证它在另一种环境中同样可靠。
items.en: Strong AI performance in one hospital setting does not guarantee equal reliability in another.
answers: Strong AI performance in one hospital setting does not guarantee equal reliability in another.
Strong AI performance in one hospital setting doesn't guarantee equal reliability in another.
items.notes: guarantee 后可直接接名词。

items.zh: 诊断工具应帮助医生检查可能性，而不应掩盖判断中的不确定性。
items.en: Diagnostic tools should help clinicians examine possibilities rather than conceal uncertainty in their judgement.
answers: Diagnostic tools should help clinicians examine possibilities rather than conceal uncertainty in their judgement.
items.notes: rather than 连接 examine 与 conceal。

items.zh: 能够追溯训练数据的来源，会让算法结果更容易接受审查。
items.en: Traceable sources of training data can make algorithmic results easier to scrutinise.
answers: Traceable sources of training data can make algorithmic results easier to scrutinise.
items.notes: scrutinise：仔细审查。

items.zh: 如果模型只能解释成功的案例，其能力可能被高估。
items.en: A model's capabilities may be overstated if only successful cases are explained.
answers: A model's capabilities may be overstated if only successful cases are explained.
items.notes: overstate：夸大；被动强调被高估的能力。

items.zh: 自动评分系统需要容纳合理的新颖表达，否则学生可能被迫迎合固定格式。
items.en: Automated marking needs to accommodate valid original expression, or students may be pushed towards fixed formats.
answers: Automated marking needs to accommodate valid original expression, or students may be pushed towards fixed formats.
items.notes: or 在此表示否则的后果。

items.zh: 当聊天机器人模仿人的情感时，用户可能忘记自己正在与软件交互。
items.en: Users may forget they are interacting with software when a chatbot imitates human emotions.
answers: Users may forget they are interacting with software when a chatbot imitates human emotions.
items.notes: interact with：与某对象交互。

items.zh: 版权规则需要明确训练材料的使用条件，同时为研究保留合理空间。
items.en: Copyright rules need to clarify conditions for using training material while preserving reasonable scope for research.
answers: Copyright rules need to clarify conditions for using training material while preserving reasonable scope for research.
items.notes: while doing 表达同时兼顾。

items.zh: 开源软件使更多人能够检查代码，但并不意味着漏洞会自动被修复。
items.en: Open-source software allows wider inspection of code without ensuring that vulnerabilities are automatically fixed.
answers: Open-source software allows wider inspection of code without ensuring that vulnerabilities are automatically fixed.
items.notes: without ensuring：并不保证。

items.zh: 关键系统依赖少数无偿维护者，会使整个服务面临持续性风险。
items.en: Reliance on a few unpaid maintainers can threaten the continuity of critical systems.
answers: Reliance on a few unpaid maintainers can threaten the continuity of critical systems.
items.notes: reliance on：对某人的依赖。

items.zh: 安全更新的责任不应在设备售出后立即终止。
items.en: Responsibility for security updates should not end as soon as a device is sold.
answers: Responsibility for security updates should not end as soon as a device is sold.
items.notes: as soon as 表达紧接发生的时间。

items.zh: 联网家电收集的数据，可能透露用户何时离家。
items.en: Data gathered by connected appliances may reveal when users are away from home.
answers: Data gathered by connected appliances may reveal when users are away from home.
items.notes: gathered 为分词定语；when 引出信息内容。

items.zh: 默认开启的数据共享设置，可能让不熟悉菜单的用户失去隐私控制权。
items.en: Data sharing enabled by default may weaken privacy control for users unfamiliar with settings menus.
answers: Data sharing enabled by default may weaken privacy control for users unfamiliar with settings menus.
items.notes: by default：默认情况下。

items.zh: 双重验证能增加账户保护，但恢复流程也必须方便合法用户使用。
items.en: Two-factor authentication can strengthen account protection, but recovery must remain accessible to legitimate users.
answers: Two-factor authentication can strengthen account protection, but recovery must remain accessible to legitimate users.
items.notes: remain + 形容词：保持某种状态。

items.zh: 诈骗信息往往利用紧迫感，让收件人在核实身份之前采取行动。
items.en: Fraudulent messages often exploit urgency to make recipients act before verifying the sender's identity.
answers: Fraudulent messages often exploit urgency to make recipients act before verifying the sender's identity.
items.notes: make sb do；exploit urgency：利用紧迫感。

items.zh: 儿童很难判断广告与普通内容的区别，尤其是两者外观相似时。
items.en: Children may struggle to distinguish advertising from ordinary content, especially when both look similar.
answers: Children may struggle to distinguish advertising from ordinary content, especially when both look similar.
items.notes: distinguish A from B：区分两者。

items.zh: 限制未成年人的消费额度，可能比只延长服务条款更有实际帮助。
items.en: Spending limits for minors may offer more practical protection than longer terms of service.
answers: Spending limits for minors may offer more practical protection than longer terms of service.
items.notes: more ... than 比较保护措施。

items.zh: 父母持续追踪孩子的位置，可能影响孩子逐步建立独立判断的机会。
items.en: Constant parental location tracking may limit children's opportunities to develop independent judgement.
answers: Constant parental location tracking may limit children's opportunities to develop independent judgement.
items.notes: opportunities to do：做某事的机会。

items.zh: 平台若只奖励互动量，具有煽动性的内容就可能更容易得到传播。
items.en: Inflammatory content may spread more readily when platforms reward engagement alone.
answers: Inflammatory content may spread more readily when platforms reward engagement alone.
items.notes: engagement 在平台语境中指互动。

items.zh: 删除虚假帖子可以减少传播，却无法让已经看过它的人自动忘记其中的信息。
items.en: Removing a false post can limit its circulation without making previous readers forget its contents.
answers: Removing a false post can limit its circulation without making previous readers forget its contents.
items.notes: without doing 限定措施的作用。

items.zh: 更正信息应尽可能触达原先接触过错误内容的受众。
items.en: Corrections should, where possible, reach the audience exposed to the original misinformation.
answers: Corrections should, where possible, reach the audience exposed to the original misinformation.
items.notes: exposed to 为修饰 audience 的分词短语。

items.zh: 网络匿名既能保护敏感话题的讨论，也可能增加追责的难度。
items.en: Online anonymity can protect discussion of sensitive issues while making accountability more difficult.
answers: Online anonymity can protect discussion of sensitive issues while making accountability more difficult.
items.notes: while making 对照并存的影响。

items.zh: 小企业迁移到云服务后，仍需理解数据备份由谁负责。
items.en: After moving to cloud services, small firms still need to understand who is responsible for backups.
answers: After moving to cloud services, small firms still need to understand who is responsible for backups.
items.notes: who 从句使用陈述语序。

items.zh: 不同系统之间无法交换数据，可能使数字化投资的收益大打折扣。
items.en: An inability to exchange data between systems may substantially reduce the benefits of digital investment.
answers: An inability to exchange data between systems may substantially reduce the benefits of digital investment.
items.notes: an inability to do：无法做某事。

items.zh: 电子记录便于检索，前提是文件命名和访问权限得到了妥善管理。
items.en: Electronic records are easier to retrieve provided that naming conventions and access permissions are managed properly.
answers: Electronic records are easier to retrieve provided that naming conventions and access permissions are managed properly.
items.notes: provided that 表示必要的支持条件。

items.zh: 在偏远地区，网络连接不稳定可能比缺少新设备更妨碍数字服务。
items.en: Unreliable connectivity may obstruct digital services in remote areas more than a shortage of new devices.
answers: Unreliable connectivity may obstruct digital services in remote areas more than a shortage of new devices.
items.notes: more than 比较两种障碍。

items.zh: 卫星互联网能扩大覆盖，但其价格仍可能让最需要连接的人望而却步。
items.en: Satellite internet can extend coverage, yet its price may exclude those who need connectivity most.
answers: Satellite internet can extend coverage, yet its price may exclude those who need connectivity most.
items.notes: those who 指特定群体。

items.zh: 自动驾驶车辆需要应对罕见情况，而不只是熟悉的道路条件。
items.en: Autonomous vehicles must handle unusual situations as well as familiar road conditions.
answers: Autonomous vehicles must handle unusual situations as well as familiar road conditions.
items.notes: as well as 补充另一类要求。

items.zh: 配送机器人上路之前，应考虑它们会如何影响行动不便的行人。
items.en: Before delivery robots enter public spaces, their effects on pedestrians with limited mobility should be considered.
answers: Before delivery robots enter public spaces, their effects on pedestrians with limited mobility should be considered.
items.notes: limited mobility：行动能力受限。

items.zh: 无人机能够快速检查受灾地区，却也需要遵守合理的隐私限制。
items.en: Drones can inspect disaster areas quickly while remaining subject to reasonable privacy restrictions.
answers: Drones can inspect disaster areas quickly while remaining subject to reasonable privacy restrictions.
items.notes: be subject to：受到约束。

items.zh: 可穿戴设备记录的数字，不能脱离个人情况被简单解释为健康结论。
items.en: Figures recorded by wearable devices should not be treated as health conclusions without personal context.
answers: Figures recorded by wearable devices should not be treated as health conclusions without personal context.
items.notes: treat A as B：将两者等同看待。

items.zh: 虚拟现实可以模拟危险任务，让培训者在实际操作前熟悉步骤。
items.en: Virtual reality can simulate hazardous tasks, allowing trainees to become familiar with procedures before working in the field.
answers: Virtual reality can simulate hazardous tasks, allowing trainees to become familiar with procedures before working in the field.
items.notes: allowing 引出模拟带来的作用。

items.zh: 数字藏品的价格上涨，并不证明它们具有稳定的长期价值。
items.en: Rising prices for digital collectibles do not establish that they have stable long-term value.
answers: Rising prices for digital collectibles do not establish that they have stable long-term value.
Rising prices for digital collectibles don't establish that they have stable long-term value.
items.notes: establish that：证实某结论。

items.zh: 电子商务扩大了市场，也让小商家更依赖少数大型平台。
items.en: E-commerce expands markets but can also make small sellers more dependent on a few large platforms.
answers: E-commerce expands markets but can also make small sellers more dependent on a few large platforms.
items.notes: dependent on：依赖于。

items.zh: 商品评价若可以被付费操纵，消费者就难以用它们判断质量。
items.en: Consumers can hardly judge quality from reviews that can be manipulated for payment.
answers: Consumers can hardly judge quality from reviews that can be manipulated for payment.
items.notes: hardly 表示几乎不能。

items.zh: 远程投票系统的便利性必须与可核验性一同考虑。
items.en: The convenience of remote voting systems must be considered alongside their verifiability.
answers: The convenience of remote voting systems must be considered alongside their verifiability.
items.notes: alongside：与……一并考虑。

items.zh: 数字遗产规则需要处理账户持有人去世后谁能访问其文件的问题。
items.en: Digital inheritance rules need to address who can access files after the account holder dies.
answers: Digital inheritance rules need to address who can access files after the account holder dies.
items.notes: address 在此表示处理问题。

items.zh: 长时间保存数据并非总有益处，因为过时的信息也可能造成错误判断。
items.en: Keeping data indefinitely is not always beneficial, since outdated information can also lead to mistaken decisions.
answers: Keeping data indefinitely is not always beneficial, since outdated information can also lead to mistaken decisions.
Keeping data indefinitely isn't always beneficial, since outdated information can also lead to mistaken decisions.
items.notes: indefinitely：无限期地。

items.zh: 技术采购的成功应看实际使用效果，而不是发布时吸引了多少关注。
items.en: Successful technology procurement should be judged by actual use, not the attention attracted at launch.
answers: Successful technology procurement should be judged by actual use, not the attention attracted at launch.
items.notes: attracted 是修饰 attention 的分词。
